SELECT ROWNUM NUM, X.BID, X.COMPANY, X.COM_NAME_LOC, X.SUBJECT, X.REG_USER_NAME, X.EMAIL, X.REG_DATE, X.MAX_BID, X.MIN_BID, X.ACL, X.LCOUNT, X.BTYPE, X.TO_DATE, X.BLEVEL, X.VID, X.ACL_DIS, X.IMAGE_KEY FROM ( SELECT BID, COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, SUBSTRB(SUBJECT,1,60) SUBJECT, REG_USER_NAME, (SELECT EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY AND USER_ID = REG_USER_ID) EMAIL, REG_DATE, (SELECT MAX(BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND BTYPE = 'BD' AND ACL = 'CST' AND OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND BTYPE||BID||COMPANY IN (SELECT BTYPE||BID||COMPANY FROM ICOMBDDT WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_company})) MAX_BID, (SELECT MIN(BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND BTYPE = 'BD' AND ACL = 'CST' AND OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND BTYPE||BID||COMPANY IN (SELECT BTYPE||BID||COMPANY FROM ICOMBDDT WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_company})) MIN_BID, ACL, LCOUNT, BTYPE, TO_DATE, BLEVEL, VID, DECODE(ACL,'INC','자사', 'BUY','구매사', 'SEL', '판매사', 'KEP','KEP','MEB','회원전체','CST','특정회사','UST','특정사용자','ALL','전체') ACL_DIS, IMAGE_KEY FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND BTYPE = 'BD' AND ACL = 'CST' AND OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND BTYPE||BID||COMPANY IN (SELECT BTYPE||BID||COMPANY FROM ICOMBDDT WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_company})
UNION
SELECT BID, COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, SUBSTRB(SUBJECT,1,60) SUBJECT, REG_USER_NAME, (SELECT EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY AND USER_ID = REG_USER_ID) EMAIL, REG_DATE, (SELECT MAX(BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND BTYPE IN ('BD','NT') AND ACL IN ('SEL','ALL')) MAX_BID, (SELECT MIN(BID) FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND BTYPE IN ('BD','NT') AND ACL IN ('SEL','ALL')) MIN_BID, ACL, LCOUNT, BTYPE, TO_DATE, BLEVEL, VID, DECODE(ACL,'INC','자사','BUY','구매사','SEL','판매사','KEP','KEP','MEB','회원전체','CST','특정회사','UST','특정사용자','ALL','전체') ACL_DIS, IMAGE_KEY FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS ! ='D' AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND BTYPE IN ('BD','NT') AND OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND ACL IN ('SEL','ALL') ) X ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC , VID DESC

/*boardBuyerDetail*/ SELECT A.BID , A.BTYPE , '고객공지' BTYPE_DIS , A.COM_CODE , A.STATUS , A.VID , A.PID , A.BLEVEL , A.ACL , DECODE(A.ACL,'INC','자사','BUY','구매사','SEL','공급사','KEP','KEP','CST','특정회사','UST','특정사용자','ALL','전체','EXP','수출') ACL_DIS , A.LCOUNT , A.SORT , A.SUBJECT , A.CONTEXT , A.REG_USER_ID , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') REG_DATE , A.REG_TIME , A.REG_DEP , A.REG_DEP_NAME , A.IMAGE_KEY ,PASSWORD ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.REG_USER_ID)REG_USER_NAME ,OPEN_FLAG ,to_char(to_date(FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') FROM_DATE ,to_char(to_date(TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') TO_DATE FROM BUYERBOARD A WHERE A.BID = #{st_bid} AND A.BTYPE = #{st_btype} AND A.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}
